title: Full ECU ROM & EEPROM Dumps Over OBD
tagline: No bench harness, no opening the ECU casing, no desoldering.
description: Standard diagnostic tools restrict you to reading fault codes. PeeweeSys unlocks full memory-read service 0x23 to stream raw flash and EEPROM data over the standard 16-pin OBD port. Verified on Bosch ME7.2 DME and Siemens / VDO Kombi instrument clusters (2048-byte 93C86 dumps).
highlights: Exact byte-for-byte binary dump of cluster calibration & DME maps
Safely verified with non-destructive, read-only memory boundary checks
Instant offline backup before any instrument cluster modification

title: Coolant Gauge Linearization
tagline: Eliminate the factory 80°C–105°C dummy flat-spot buffer.
description: From the factory, Porsche programmed the 986 and 996 coolant gauge needle to sit dead-center at 80°C (180°F) whether your actual coolant temp is 80°C, 95°C, or 105°C. PeeweeSys identifies the exact Kombi interpolation curve table in EEPROM so your needle reflects true engine temperature in real-time.
highlights: Prevents catastrophic M96 cylinder bore score and cracked heads from masked overheating
Inspect the exact 4-point temperature-to-impulse mapping table
Calculates the linearized curve so the needle actually moves when your car runs hot

title: Speedometer Recalibration
tagline: Fix 5–8% factory over-read and compensate for aftermarket wheels.
description: Nearly all 986 and 996 instrument clusters intentionally over-read speed by 4 to 8 km/h at highway velocity. PeeweeSys extracts the speedometer impulse factor `K-Zahl` stored in the cluster EEPROM, allowing you to dial in true GPS-accurate speedometer readings.
highlights: Corrects odometer and speedometer mismatch on non-OEM wheel & tire diameters
Pre-verified against Porsche factory calibration guidelines

title: Over-Rev & Operating Hours Forensics
tagline: The true health scorecard of any modern Porsche.
description: Decode DME Range 1 and Range 2 (plus Range 3–6 on 9x7) ignition over-rev counts, the operating hour timestamp of the most recent event, and total DME run hours. PeeweeSys automatically computes your lifetime average speed to expose clocked or tampered cars.
highlights: Total operating hours vs cluster odometer cross-audit
Pinpoint exact operating hour timestamp of mechanical money-shifts

title: Multi-Module Tamper Detection
tagline: Compare independent odometer registers across the car.
description: Unscrupulous sellers can adjust the digits on the instrument cluster, but rarely know how to falsify the independent run-time registers stored in the DME, ABS unit, or Tiptronic transmission. PeeweeSys pulls all registers simultaneously into one tamper-audit view.
highlights: Simultaneous reading of DME hours, Kombi odometer, and transmission operating time
Highlights statistical discrepancies (e.g. suspiciously low average speed under 20 km/h)
Zero VIN locks — scan every car you inspect before buying

title: Pre-Clear Snapshot Reports
tagline: Never lose critical diagnostic freeze frame data again.
description: Handheld scan tools erase fault codes blindly with a single press, destroying freeze frame conditions (engine RPM, engine temp, load) needed to pinpoint intermittent misfires. PeeweeSys enforces a non-destructive snapshot workflow with structured export before clearing.
highlights: Captures all DTCs, freeze frames, and module versions into a permanent HTML/PDF dossier
Strict car-tested whitelist prevents sending unverified clear commands to sensitive ECUs
Automatic post-clear re-scan confirms whether faults are static or transient
